Speaker: Narrator
Transcription: The old fisherman walked down to the harbor before sunrise.

Speaker: Narrator
Transcription: He checked his nets and found 3 holes near the bottom.

Speaker: Narrator
Transcription: His granddaughter brought him a cup of tea, and a piece of bread.

Speaker: Narrator
Transcription: Together they mended the nets while gulls circled overhead.

Speaker: Narrator
Transcription: By noon the boat was ready, and they set out across the bay.

Speaker: Grandmother
Transcription: "Remember to watch the weather to the west," she said.

Speaker: Grandmother
Transcription: The clouds over the hills always come in faster than you think.
